lines.text: Jesus teaches the crowd beside the sea, then tells Levi son of Alphaeus at the tax booth to follow Him.
Many tax collectors and sinners eat with Jesus at Levi's house, and the scribes who were Pharisees ask His disciples why.
Jesus answers that the sick need a doctor, and that He came to call sinners, not the wise.
Asked why His disciples do not fast, Jesus says the guests will fast when the bridegroom is taken from them.
Jesus says no one sews unshrunk cloth on an old garment or pours new wine into old wineskins, because the wine would sour.
